column1: # Indonesia language classification — family + primary province per ISO 639-3.
# Anchors the "by family" and "by province" groupings in id.toml.
# Nominatim (coordinate -> province reverse geocode), Wikidata (country tagging
# to shortlist candidate ISOs). Scope: intersection of Indonesia-tagged ISO
# 639-3 codes (Wikidata P17=Indonesia) against the three live content sources
# (PKF manifest, DBT media index, helloAO catalog) — see id-source-scan.md.
# STATUS: family = Glottolog top/mid-level branch, high confidence; province =
# best-effort single primary province from language-centroid coordinates, a
# few hand-corrected for cross-border languages (see notes). Review before
# treating as final — this is the same caveat mx-languages.tsv carries.
